migration.subscriptionState.biliStateUnr: Bilibili room state could not be read; room IDs were not migrated.
migration.subscriptionState.biliStateUnw: Bilibili room state failed write validation ({reason}); room IDs were not migrated.
migration.subscriptionState.droppedProfi: Skipped subscription profiles: {count}. Their format was not recognized; a profile refresh will restore them.
migration.subscriptionState.roomsDropped: Room IDs not written to Bilibili state: {invalid} invalid, {unmapped} without a matching Bilibili subscription; duplicate uid entries: {duplicates}.
migration.subscriptionState.unreadable: The subscription profile cache could not be read and was not migrated.
migration.zero.masterTargetCleared: The owner target was a group or no longer exists. It has been cleared; select a private-message target again.
migration.zero.layout.state: Settings, both subscription files, connections, targets, and internal state (subscription runtime state and roast drafts)
migration.zero.layout.secrets: Master key, key-derivation salt, AI apiKey, and Bilibili cookies
migration.zero.layout.history: Push history <day>.jsonl, historical images img/, and repush originals repush/<day>/
migration.zero.layout.stats: Posts dyn/, live streams live/, seen/ (one jsonl per subscription), and the since watermark
migration.zero.layout.fans: Follower time series, one jsonl per subscription
migration.zero.layout.assets: Card backgrounds card-bg/, chat attachments chat/, and fonts font/
migration.zero.layout.avatars: Extension subscription avatars, keyed by subscription ID
migration.zero.layout.extensions: Installed extension packages, failure records load-state.json, and marketplace sources .marketplace.json
migration.zero.inputs.adapters: Legacy name for connections.json: read once during migration if connections.json is absent; not copied to the new generation
migration.zero.inputs.extensionSubscript: Extension subscriptions: read once and merged with subscriptions.json (ADR-0021, decision 15); the old file is not copied to the new generation
migration.zero.inputs.cookies: Bilibili login: read once and converted to secrets/bilibili/secrets.enc; the old file is not copied to the new generation
migration.zero.inputs.chat: Chat attachments are not migrated with maid conversations (ADR-0022, decision 4) and remain in generation 0
migration.zero.inputs.avatars: Extension subscription avatars: read once; referenced images are copied individually to images/ and listed as transferred. Unreferenced files and the original directory are not copied.
migration.zero.inputs.cardSkins: Card skins are not migrated (ADR-0022, decision 12)
migration.zero.inputs.maidSkills: Maid skills are not migrated (ADR-0022, decision 4). Custom skills remain in generation 0; built-in skills follow the application version and are unaffected.
migration.zero.inputs.ai: Maid conversations are not migrated (ADR-0022, decision 4) and remain in generation 0. The new generation starts with an empty conversation history.
migration.zero.history.expired: Historical images skipped because only expired rows referenced them: {count}. Row text was retained and image references were removed.
migration.zero.history.orphans: Historical images with no history or repush reference were skipped: {count}.
migration.zero.history.dropped: Invalid historical images were removed from referencing rows: {count}. Files were missing, unsupported, over 8 MB, or at invalid paths.
migration.zero.history.voided: Repush originals skipped because their images were invalid for the reasons above: {count}. Those rows can no longer be repushed.
migration.zero.avatars.dropped: Invalid extension subscription avatars were removed from profiles: {count}. Files were missing, unsupported, over 8 MB, or at invalid paths. A future extension profile report can restore them.
migration.zero.avatars.orphans: Avatar files with no profile reference were skipped: {count}.
migration.zero.biliLoginFailed: Bilibili login was not migrated ({reason}); scan the QR code again.
